sourceChecks.text: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 斥候の報告はアマレクが南部に住むとする。ここでは民の呼称として扱う。

sourceChecks.text: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBのこの節に現れるアマレク人の用法を確認。

sourceChecks.text: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following the LORD; therefore the LORD will not be with you.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBのこの節に現れるアマレク人の用法を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBのこの節に現れるアマレク人の用法を確認。

sourceChecks.text: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBのこの節に現れるアマレク人の用法を確認。
